title: vscode web / Relationship to {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} Desktop
content:
## Relationship to {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} Desktop

{% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} for the Web provides a browser-based experience for navigating files and repositories and committing lightweight code changes. However, if you need access to a runtime to run, build, or debug your code, you want to use platform features such as a terminal, or you want to run extensions that aren't supported in the web, we recommend moving your work to the desktop application, [GitHub Codespaces](https://github.com/features/codespaces), or using [Remote - Tunnels](#use-your-own-compute-instance-with-remote-tunnels) for the full capabilities of {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}. In addition, {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} Desktop lets you use a full set of keyboard shortcuts not limited by your browser.

When you're ready to switch, you'll be able to ["upgrade"](#continue-working-in-a-different-environment) to the full {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} experience with a few clicks.

You can also switch between the Stable and Insiders versions of {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} for the Web by selecting the gear icon, then **Switch to Insiders Version...**, or by navigating directly to [https://insiders.vscode.dev](https://insiders.vscode.dev).
